cases.title: UNIQA Integration: Automated Warranty Policy Generation
cases.summary: Automation and workflow design connecting webshop and insurer systems.
cases.impact: Reduced warranty processing time by over 70%.
cases.problem: Warranty policy generation had too many manual steps, slowing processing and increasing operational cost.
cases.approach: Defined workflows and data mapping, aligned stakeholders, coordinated implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
cases.outcome: Automation reduced manual work and improved turnaround time for warranty processing.

cases.title: Dropshipping + Logistics Integrations

cases.problem: Delivery operations needed faster fulfillment and consistent handoffs across multiple partners.
cases.approach: Integrated dropshipping with TISAK and coordinated multiple logistics partners to streamline flows and reduce friction.
cases.outcome: More predictable delivery and faster order handoffs across the network.
